findings.evidence: The output says any assistant accepting pasted instructions can use the package, while also stating no IDE was tested.
findings.impact: The generic manual-use claim is more certain than the available compatibility evidence. The adjacent untested caveat limits the impact but is not a test.
findings.repair: Describe manual use as inferred and untested; avoid claiming it works for any class of hosts.
findings.retest: Repeat creator-edge on the repaired hash. All native and manual compatibility statements must remain explicitly tentative or supported by an actual test.
